subject: humanities
passage: Michelangelo left several marble figures, the so-called Prisoners now displayed in Florence, only partly carved, so that bodies seem to twist and strain out of rough, unworked stone. Some viewers, assuming the figures were simply abandoned, have wished that a later sculptor had finished them. Yet completion would have ______ the very quality that many admirers prize most in these works: the tension between the shaped figure and the raw block, which invites the viewer to imagine the form still in the act of emerging.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: "Yet" introduces an objection to finishing the statues. The prized quality depends on the figures being unfinished ("still in the act of emerging"), so completing them would make that quality impossible. The blank must mean "ruled out" or "shut off."
explanation.A: Correct. "Foreclosed" means made impossible in advance, which fits completion eliminating the sense of a form still emerging.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Finishing the figures would remove the raw stone, so it would weaken the tension between figure and block, not intensify it.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Parodied" means imitated mockingly; nothing suggests a later sculptor would mock the works.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Documented" means recorded. Finishing the carving would not record the unfinished quality; it would erase it.
